key_insight: SACK prioritizes incoming samples by their semantic relationship to previously learned concepts, improving continual learning while reducing forgetting.
engineering_relevance: SACK could support engineering models that learn sequentially from new datasets, although the abstract does not demonstrate solid mechanics or constitutive modeling applications.
method: Decompose learned categorical knowledge into fine-grained concepts.
Compute relationships between previously learned and incoming concepts.
Use concept relationships to prioritize new samples within existing continual learning methods.
evidence_signal: Experiments with regularization-, replay-, and prompt-based methods in class- and task-incremental settings report improved accuracy, reduced forgetting, and better calibration and robustness, without numerical results in the abstract.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify the computational overhead of concept extraction and sample prioritization.
paper_title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
